featured.title: Nemotron 3.5 Super and Lightning: Open, Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Hybrid Mamba-Transformer Models for Agentic AI
featured.tldr: NVIDIA's open Nemotron 3.5 Super, a 120B-parameter hybrid Mamba-Transformer mixture-of-experts with 12B active, adds a built-in drafter and 4-bit weights, reaching 51.78% on SWE-bench Pro.

featured.title: TRACE: Rollout-Guided Quantization-Aware Training for FP4 Reinforcement Learning of MoE Language Models
featured.tldr: TRACE makes the training and rollout sides round to the same FP4 value, so reinforcement learning of mixture-of-experts models can use 4-bit rollouts with BF16-level scores and up to 5.4 times faster generation.
